items.steps: RULE: a knob k in {lp30, dc0.30, fm45} is POSITIVE if its single variant displays >= 0.955, or displays 0.954 and its scoring moved our team up inside the 0.954 block. It is NEGATIVE if its single displays <= 0.953. (a) Once the singles are known, submit the combination of all POSITIVE knobs that has not been scored yet (e.g. lp30+fm45 = exp70c, sha a7271d4e...: the exp70a command + --patch forkmid --set FORKMID_ENABLE=1, name exp70c_k2_lp30_fm45; or lp30+dc0.30+fm45 = exp70f). (b) Never submit a combination that contains a NEGATIVE knob. (c) STOP the ladder when two consecutive rungs fail to beat the best display, or when no untested combination of POSITIVE knobs remains; unused slots stay empty. (d) No threshold neighbours (dc 0.275, lp 0.5, forkmid 4.0): they are pure public fitting with no lab support.

items.steps: (1) CLASSES: A = exp70a (K2 + lp30). B = K2 + any other subset of {lp30, dc0.30, forkmid 4.5} (exp70b/c/d/e/f). C = everything else (exp70t, secondary weight, any re-tuned threshold or neighbour); a class-C file is never a final. (2) A variant is ELIGIBLE iff: it is COMPLETE with no error; its runtime L_hi <= 9.0 h by tools/runtime_ledger.py (family safetail); its displayed public score is >= 0.955; and every knob in it has its own single-knob variant displayed >= 0.954 wherever that single was scored. (3) PICK V* = the highest displayed score; ties -> class A before B, then fewer knobs, then the earlier submission. (4) PAIR = {V*, twin #38 56563534}, and #37 leaves: V* is K2 plus lab-signed knobs, and the twin keeps the insertion hedge. With no eligible V*, the pair stays {#37, #38}. (5) If E10 v2 is in force and a port is adopted, the pair is {PORT, V*}, or {PORT, #37} if there is no V*. (6) Only scores present in poll.log by 29 Sep 19:00Z count. The user ticks by 20:00Z, and the session checks API SELECTED (group SUBMISSION_GROUP_SELECTED). (7) NEVER tick: a class-C file, #34, #35, P36, two files with identical components, a non-COMPLETE file, or the pair {V*, #37} (it drops the insertion hedge). (8) The displayed public score and rank are not medals. If nothing qualifies, a 0.955 on the board from a class-C file is fine as display, and the finals do not change.

summary: WHY NOT US: the 0.955-0.957 teams have not published their code. The likely sources are model-level changes (y3uanm fine-tuned the secondary: 0.949 -> 0.956), weeks of public-LB knob probing (which our R7 forbade), or private sharing. We show 0.954, but we are 12th of 97 inside the 0.954 block, so our best unrounded score is plausibly ~0.9542-0.9545 and +0.0001..+0.0003 can flip the display to 0.955. 0.956+ is out of reach with knobs alone. TONIGHT (if the user lifts R7; this agent dry-built every variant and checked the bytes; the K2 rebuild is identical, 1f1ddb6d): S1 exp70a = K2 + leaf prune 0.3. Best prior: P36 beat #35 unrounded on public; lab +0.0008 on 51/56 clips; class A. S2 exp70d = K2 + DeepCenter safe-div 0.30. Lab: 6bba, out-of-sample for DeepCenter, +0.0010; 44b6 -0.0006; a cliff at 0.35; class B. S3 exp70e = both knobs; with K2 this makes a 2x2 factorial. Push the dummies ~21:00Z and submit 22:15-23:30Z (hard 23:50Z); scores arrive ~06:30-07:30Z on 27 Sep. 27 Sep: 00:05Z exp70b = K2 + forkmid 4.5; ~08:00Z informed combos under a stop rule. 28 Sep is reserve; the last ladder submit is 29 Sep 11:00Z. Honest expectation: +0.000..+0.0003 public per knob; P(some variant shows 0.955) ~0.35-0.5; private effect ~0..+0.0003. Otherwise the finals stay #37 + #38. TRAP: x138 cells 3-4 hard-set SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT and the other SECONDARY_/DUAL_SEED_ knobs, so a --set on them is silently ignored and wastes a slot.
